cohort: Pregnant women who had childbirth at term in Bowen University Teaching Hospital (BUTH), Ogbomoso, Nigeria, from 01 January 2018 to 31 December 2020.
finding: Maternal comorbidities and number of gestation were significantly associated with birth weight.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 3.15+-0.56 kg; 90.3% normal birth weight, 6.7% low birth weight, and 3.0% high birth weight
